title: Fix token mint scope format: comma-separated vs space-separated
description: smallhold's 'token mint' CLI command outputs scopes as comma-separated ('read,write,follow') but the API scope checker (api.rs:248) splits on whitespace. Tokens minted via CLI fail write-scope checks. Fix: either change token mint to use space-separated scopes, or change the scope checker to handle both formats.
close_reason: Fixed: CLI default scopes changed from comma to space-separated. Scope checker updated to handle both formats.
